title: Hawaiian Cheesecake
description: This tropical cheesecake in a prepared graham cracker crust is studded with coconut and pecans for a Hawaiian-inspired dessert that's sure to be a hit.
ingredients: 1 cup granular no-calorie sucralose sweetener (such as Splenda®)
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed
3 tablespoons finely flaked coconut, or to taste
1 tablespoon crushed pecans, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Beat together cream cheese, sweetened condensed milk, sweetener, 1 cup coconut, eggs, milk, 1/4 cup pecans, vanilla, and salt in a large bowl until smooth; pour into the prepared crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until filling is set and slightly browned around the edges, 35 to 40 minutes.
Refrigerate cheesecake for 8 hours to overnight.
Spread pineapple evenly over cooled cheesecake and top with whipped topping. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons coconut and 1 tablespoon pecans over whipped topping.

video.description: Dessert goes tropical in this flavorful homage to Hawaii! Make your cheesecake base with cream cheese, sweetened condensed milk, sweetener, flaked coconut, milk, crushed pecans, eggs, vanilla and salt. Pour into a prepared graham cracker crust and bake. Chill overnight and serve topped with crushed pineapple, whipped topping, coconut and pecans. Crunchy, sweet, tangy and creamy dessert pleasure is in every slice!
